title: Jorjani's great aunt talking with dead relatives on her deathbed

tellings.quote: one case was my great aunt or I was there while she was like describing to not just not describing she was having conversations with dead relatives

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani says that his great aunt, as she lay dying in a hospital room, was not just describing her dead relatives but actually having conversations with them. Jorjani was there and tells it as a case he saw himself, the kind that would suggest the dying can reach the dead.
